metadata.name: Ecodesign for Vue
metadata.description: Ecodesign rules for Vue: computed over watchers, lazy routes, shallow state for large data.

reactivite.name: Vue — reactivity
reactivite.description: Deep reactivity on a large object costs on every read and every write (RGESN Frontend).

rules.title: Deep watcher on a large object
rules.description: A watcher with deep: true walks the whole object graph on every change to decide whether anything moved. On a large payload that traversal happens far more often than the change it is looking for.
rules.recommendation: Watch the specific property that matters, or derive the value with computed. Use shallowRef for large immutable payloads.
rules.source_note: Adapted from the Green Codex rule LANG-VUE-001 (Institut du Numerique Responsable), whose rule content is published under CC BY 4.0. Reworded for this format; the patterns are specific to this audit.

rules.title: Route loaded eagerly
rules.description: Importing every route at the top of the router ships the whole application to a visitor who opens one page.
rules.recommendation: Load routes with a dynamic import so each page arrives when someone navigates to it.
rules.note: One dynamic import or defineAsyncComponent anywhere in the file silences the rule. A component used on every route is legitimately imported eagerly.
